name: Economics
description: A-Level Economics for Forms V and VI covering microeconomic and macroeconomic principles, national income, trade, public finance, and development planning in the Tanzanian context.

subtopics.title: Definition and Scope of Economics
outcomes: Define Economics as a social science
Explain the relevance of Economics to everyday life

subtopics.title: Basic Economic Problems
outcomes: Identify the fundamental economic problem of scarcity
Explain how scarcity forces individuals and societies to make choices
Apply the concept of opportunity cost to real-life decisions
Analyse trade-offs faced by a developing country like Tanzania

subtopics.title: Factors of Production
outcomes: List the four factors of production and their rewards
Explain the roles of land, labour, capital and entrepreneurship
Apply the concept of factors of production to a local business

subtopics.title: Economic Systems
